# INTERIM REPORT OF GRAM-POSITIVE COCCI IN PAIRS AND CLUSTERS

This suggests staphylococci. Empirical therapy should cover methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus. If a susceptible isolate is identified, beta-lactam antimicrobials should be used as they are most effective at killing staphylococci. When a final pathogen is identified, treatment depends on which specific bacterium is identified.
